onboarding.title: Begin Your NariCare Journey
onboarding.description: Fill in your preferences below to begin your NariCare journey.

health.topic: What would you like help with today?
health.concern_placeholder: Describe what you have been noticing in your own words. You do not need medical terminology.
health.concern_example: My periods have been irregular for 3 months and I feel very tired.
health.duration: How Long Have You Noticed This?

medical_translator.title: Medical Language Translator
medical_translator.placeholder: Paste a medical term from your report or prescription here.
medical_translator.description: Medical language can be confusing. NariCare translates it into plain language so you know what to ask your doctor.

privacy.title: Your Privacy and Safety
privacy.ask_only_needed: We ask only what we need
privacy.no_diagnosis: NariCare does not diagnose any condition.
privacy.no_replacement: NariCare does not replace professional medical advice.
privacy.no_persistent_storage: The prototype does not persistently store health data.
privacy.no_sensitive_id: NariCare does not require Aadhaar, address, or sensitive identification.

accessibility_commitment.title: Accessibility Commitment
accessibility_commitment.description: NariCare is designed from the beginning for blind, deaf or hard-of-hearing, and non-disabled users. The AI adapts its communication style, not just its content, based on accessibility preferences.

prototype.title: Prototype Disclosure
prototype.description: This is a PartyRock prototype demonstrating NariCare's AI-powered health navigation engine. A production system would integrate secure authentication, persistent user profiles, and appropriate healthcare privacy compliance.

voice_assistant.title: Voice Assistant and Screen Reader Guide
voice_assistant.description: NariCare is designed to work with screen readers and assistive technologies.

keyboard.tab: Move to the next input field or button
keyboard.enter_space: Select an option or activate a button

footer.tagline: Turn "I don't know whether this matters" into "I understand my next step."
